z80zhealthbar.settings.title: Z80Z Health Bar Settings
z80zhealthbar.settings.pagedesc.main: Master switches, current setup overview and quick actions; detailed options live on sub-pages
z80zhealthbar.settings.pagedesc.style: Only the active style's settings are shown; switch styles above
z80zhealthbar.settings.pagedesc.popup: Theme, motion and feedback of damage numbers
z80zhealthbar.advanced.reload.tooltip: Re-read z80zhealthbar.json from disk; handy after manual edits (the file also hot-reloads automatically on save).
z80zhealthbar.compat.server_note: Saturation/exhaustion/absorption sync activates when the server also has Z80Zhealthbar.
z80zhealthbar.advanced.import_failed: Import failed: clipboard is not valid config JSON.
z80zhealthbar.advanced.path_copied: Config file path copied to clipboard.
z80zhealthbar.editor.title: HUD Layout Editor
z80zhealthbar.editor.hint: Click & drag components • Scroll to scale • Arrows to nudge (Shift = 10px)
z80zhealthbar.damagePopup.note: Exact numbers require the server to run this mod; estimated mode undercounts damage absorbed by absorption.
z80zhealthbar.hud.enable.tooltip: Master switch for the player HUD (health, armor, air, XP). Off restores the vanilla HUD.
z80zhealthbar.entity.enable.tooltip: Master switch for entity health bars, shared by all entity styles.
z80zhealthbar.entity.style.tooltip: Entity bar style: OFF=disabled; MOBHEALTHBAR=textured bar; MOBPLAQUES=vanilla-icon plaques; ASTEORBAR=dynamic color bar. Fine-tune each on the Entity Style page.
z80zhealthbar.hud.style.tooltip: Player HUD style: VANILLA=keep vanilla; ASTEORBAR=bar layouts (9 variants); CUSTOM=editable layout (use the layout editor).
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.barType.tool: Bar shape: Framed=textured frame with tinted fill; Heart row=vanilla hearts stacked in rows; Classic bar=procedural recreation of the original wide bar.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.scaleBar.too: Overall scale of the style 1 bar (width, height and text together); use Width/Height stretch below for single-axis tweaks.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.showName.too: Show the entity's name above the bar.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.showHp.toolt: Show the exact health value next to the bar.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barScale.t: Overall scale of the style 3 dynamic bar (100% = default).
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barAlpha.t: Opacity of the style 3 bar (0 = invisible, 255 = opaque).
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barHalfWid: Half width of the bar in pixels: 0 = auto (follows max health, 2px per point, clamped 20-80px); non-zero = fixed total width (half x2). Previously this setting was not wired to the renderer; legacy configs migrated to auto. Style 3 (bar) only: style 1 uses Bar scale, style 2 uses Max row width.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.healthBarH: Tint the bar by health ratio (green-yellow-red). Off uses a fixed color.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.originalRe: Debug: line-by-line recreation of AsteorBar's rendering pipeline. Leave off for normal use.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.integerHea: Round health numbers for display (e.g. 17). Off shows decimals (e.g. 17.5). Applies to the value text of style 1 and style 3; style 2 plaques are integer by design.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.plaqueS: Overall plaque scale for style 2 (50% = default).
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.maxPlaq: Max width of one plaque row in pixels before wrapping; 0 = unlimited.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.maxRend: Style 2 plaque distance cap (halved while crouching). The nearer of this and the Visibility page's Max Distance applies.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.scaleWi: Grow plaques with distance so distant mobs stay readable.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.plaqueB: Draw a translucent backdrop behind plaques for readability in bright scenes.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.behindW: On: plaques render through walls (skips occlusion checks, fastest). Off: only line-of-sight targets get plaques.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.origina: Debug: line-by-line recreation of Mob Plaques' renderer. Leave off for normal use.
z80zhealthbar.option.addons.armorRow.too: Append an armor icon row under style 1/3 bars (style 2's armor row is controlled by the plaque settings).
z80zhealthbar.option.addons.toughnessRow: Append an armor toughness icon row under style 1/3 bars.
z80zhealthbar.option.addons.airRow.toolt: Append an air bubble row under style 1/3 bars (shown underwater).
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.enabled: Damage popups: floating damage numbers above hit entities.
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.theme.t: Color theme: APEX=shield blue/health white/kill red; TACTICAL=mono white with gold big hits; WARFRAME=per-type colored digits; CLASSIC=classic type colors; MINIMAL=minimal white.
Motion: RISE=float upward; ARC=pop out and fall; STACK=tower stack (new on top); CUMULATIVE=merge hits into a running total.
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.estimat: When the server lacks this mod, estimate damage from client-side health deltas (absorbed damage reads low).
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.lifetim: How long a popup stays visible (ticks; 20 ticks = 1 second).
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.maxPerE: Max popups on one entity at once; the oldest is dropped beyond this.
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.mergeWi: Merge damage within this window into one summed popup (xn); 0 = off.
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.launchA: RISE/ARC popups jump out from above the head at a random angle within ±this value of straight up (0 = vertical; each hit rolls its own angle; RISE/ARC only).
z80zhealthbar.option.damagePopup.hitMark: Show an FPS-style hitmarker at the crosshair on hit.
Play a sound cue together with the hitmarker.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnSe: Also show a bar above yourself (third-person view).
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnBo: Show bars on bosses (Ender Dragon, Wither, ...).
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnAr: Show bars on armor stands (mostly for debugging).
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnFu: Also show bars on entities at full health without absorption.
Also show bars on entities at full health that have absorption.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showDama: Show bars on entities that have taken damage at least once.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnAg: Only show bars on entities whose attack target is you.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showHove: Always show a bar for the entity under your crosshair, regardless of the rules above.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.showOnly: Line-of-sight check: only render entities you can actually see (small raycast cost).
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.maxDista: Global max distance (blocks) for bars and popups. Style 2 has its own Plaque Distance cap; the nearer one applies.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.maxConcu: Max bars on screen at once (0 = unlimited); first come first served, slots free after ~2s.
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.fadeInTi: Fade-in duration when a bar appears (ticks; 0 = instant).
z80zhealthbar.option.visibility.fadeOnDe: Fade the bar out with the death animation; off = vanish instantly.
z80zhealthbar.option.hud.layoutStyle.too: Long-bar layout variant (1-8; 0 = disable this mode's drawing). Only applies while HUD style is Long Bars.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.displayHeal: Show numeric values on the health bar (e.g. 15/20).
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.displayFood: Show numeric values on the hunger bar.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.displayExpe: Show XP progress as a percentage.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overwriteVa: Replace the vanilla armor icon row with a custom bar. Off keeps vanilla drawing.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.enableHealt: Blink the health bar while health is below the low-health threshold.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.enableFoodB: Blink the hunger bar while hunger is low.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.shakeHealth: Shake health and hunger bars while they are low.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.lowHealthRa: Low-health threshold (fraction of max health) that triggers blinking/shaking.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.absorptionM: 吸收值的显示方式：同行附加 = 金色段接在生命段之后；仅图标 = 只显示吸收金心与 +N 文本。
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.hideUnchang: Auto-hide bars whose values stopped changing after this many seconds (0 = never).
z80zhealthbar.settings.open_editor.toolt: Open the HUD layout editor to drag components around (switches HUD style to CUSTOM).
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.health.toolt: Health component mode: BAR=custom bar, ICON=vanilla icons, OFF=hidden. Position/scale via the layout editor.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.food.tooltip: Hunger component mode: BAR=custom bar, ICON=vanilla icons, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.air.tooltip: Air component mode: BAR=custom bar, ICON=vanilla bubbles, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.experience.t: Experience component mode: BAR=progress bar, ICON=vanilla bar+level, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.armor.toolti: Armor component mode: BAR=custom bar, ICON=vanilla icons, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.mount.toolti: Mount health component (shown while riding): BAR=custom bar, ICON=icons, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.hud.component.compat.toolt: Compat data component (thirst/stamina etc.): BAR=custom bar, ICON=icons, OFF=hidden.
z80zhealthbar.compat.appleskin.tooltip: AppleSkin: feeds saturation/exhaustion estimates so the hunger bar reads accurately.
z80zhealthbar.compat.thirst.tooltip: Thirst Was Taken: reads the thirst stat into a compat status bar.
z80zhealthbar.compat.parcool.tooltip: ParCool!: reads stamina into a compat status bar.
z80zhealthbar.compat.toughasnails.toolti: Tough As Nails: temperature/thirst data hook (reserved; no dedicated component yet).
z80zhealthbar.compat.botania.tooltip: Botania: mana data hook (reserved; no dedicated component yet).
z80zhealthbar.compat.mekanism.tooltip: Mekanism: oxygen/gear data hook (reserved; no dedicated component yet).
z80zhealthbar.compat.vampirism.tooltip: Vampirism: blood pool data hook (reserved; no dedicated component yet).
z80zhealthbar.compat.feathers.tooltip: Feathers: feather stamina data hook (reserved; no dedicated component yet).
z80zhealthbar.advanced.export.tooltip: Copy the full config JSON to the clipboard for backup or sharing.
z80zhealthbar.advanced.import.tooltip: Read config JSON from the clipboard and apply it (overwrites current settings).
z80zhealthbar.advanced.reset_all.tooltip: Reset every setting (including HUD layout) to defaults.
z80zhealthbar.advanced.reset_layout.tool: Reset only the custom HUD layout positions to defaults.
z80zhealthbar.advanced.open_file.tooltip: Copy the config file's full path to the clipboard for manual editing.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overlayText: Overall scale of HUD value texts (100% = default).
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.showArm: Show or hide style 2's armor plaque row.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.showTou: Show or hide style 2's toughness plaque row.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.showAir: Show or hide style 2's air plaque row (underwater).
z80zhealthbar.settings.style_off_hint: Entity bars are currently off — pick a style above to enable them and show its settings.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.colorVariant: Frame/fill scheme: Steel=red, Blood=orange, Gold=green, Arcane=blue. Applies to framed and classic bars; heart rows keep vanilla heart colors.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barVariant: Fill look: Flat=solid color; Gradient=brighter top fading to darker bottom; Segmented=configurable cells with gaps; Glossy=solid with top highlight and bottom shadow. Status tint and absorption rings apply to all variants.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.segmentCou: Fixed cell count for the Segmented fill variant: 1-64, default 10. HP per cell = max health / count. Cell widths vary by at most 1px when the bar width isn't divisible by the count; pick a divisor of the bar width for perfectly even cells. Only applies while HP per segment is set to Even split.
Segmented variant mode: Even split = divide by segment count; a fixed value (e.g. 2=vanilla heart semantics, 50=a 500HP boss gets 10 cells) makes cell count = max health / value, scaling per mob (merged beyond 64). Cell widths vary by at most 1px when the bar width isn't divisible by the count.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.segmentWho: When on, health that doesn't fill a whole segment is not shown (floors to full cells). Segmented variant only.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barHalfHei: Half height of the bar in pixels; total height = value x2.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barTextSca: Scale of the health value text (100% = default), independent of the bar.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barTextOff: Horizontal offset of the value text in bar pixels; positive moves right.
Vertical offset of the value text in bar pixels; positive moves down.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.scaleName.to: Scale of the style 1 name text (100% = default).
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.scaleNums.to: Scale of the style 1 health value text (100% = default).
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.heightOffset: How far above the entity the bar floats (blocks); fine-tune the gap to the vanilla nametag line.
z80zhealthbar.settings.preview.title: Live preview
z80zhealthbar.settings.preview.barOff: Entity bars are off (master switch on the Home page)
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.enabled.toolt: Master switch for bar effects: smooth transitions, damage ghost, hurt flash.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.smooth.toolti: Fill eases toward the new health value (~90ms) instead of jumping per frame.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.ghost.tooltip: After damage, a pale ghost segment lingers at the old value and shrinks slowly, showing recently lost health; heals catch up instantly.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.hurtFlash.too: The fill flashes toward white while the entity is in hurt invulnerability, then fades.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.lowHpPulse.to: Fill brightness breathes while below the low-health threshold (mob bars: 30%).
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.sheen.tooltip: A moving highlight band sweeps across the fill periodically.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.healGlow.tool: Fill briefly glows green when healing.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.hitShake.tool: The bar shakes on hit, decaying with the hurt flash.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.spawnPop.tool: Bars scale-pop and drop in when first shown (220ms).
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.healLift.tool: The bar lifts briefly while the mob regenerates.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.deathShrink.t: The bar shrinks toward its anchor and sinks on death.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.shatter.toolt: The bar shatters into flying shards on death (bar styles; hearts/plaques fall back to fading).
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.note: Applies to bar shapes (style 1 framed/classic, style 3 bar) and their value text; heart rows are discrete icons and unaffected. Watch the live preview on the right.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.numRoll.toolt: The health value rolls smoothly to its new value (ARPG counter style) instead of jumping.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.numPunch.tool: On hurt the value scales up 30% outward from its own center.
z80zhealthbar.option.barfx.numTint.toolt: The value flashes red on damage and green on healing, fading back to white.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.offsetX.tool: Shift the bar itself left/right in pixels; positive moves right. Text is unaffected.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.offsetY.tool: Shift the bar itself up/down in pixels; positive moves down. Text is unaffected.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.xOffset: Shift plaque rows left/right in plaque pixels; positive moves right. Use "Plaque Y offset" for vertical placement.
z80zhealthbar.option.barStyle.barPixelOf: Shift the bar itself left/right in bar pixels; positive moves right. Text stays put and follows its own text offset.
Shift the bar itself up/down in bar pixels; positive moves down. Text stays put and follows its own text offset.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.numOffsetX.t: Horizontal offset of the value text in pixels; positive moves right. Independent of the bar offset.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.numOffsetY.t: Vertical offset of the value text in pixels; positive moves down. Independent of the bar offset.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.opacity.tool: Overall opacity of the bar (0=invisible, 255=opaque); frame, fill, name and value fade together.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.yOffset: Shift plaque rows up/down in plaque pixels; positive moves down.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.opacity: Overall opacity of the plaques (0=invisible, 255=opaque); icons, background and values fade together.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.textSca: Scale of the plaque value text (100% = default); row width recalculates to fit.
z80zhealthbar.option.plaqueStyle.textOff: Horizontal offset of the plaque value text in plaque pixels; positive moves right.
Vertical offset of the plaque value text in plaque pixels; positive moves down.
z80zhealthbar.editor.panel.title: Properties
z80zhealthbar.editor.icon_mode_note: Icon mode has no bar options; use Component scale to resize
z80zhealthbar.editor.off_mode_note: Component hidden; switch back to Bar or Icons to show it
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overwriteVa: Replace the vanilla XP bar with the custom one. Off keeps vanilla drawing.
z80zhealthbar.editor.text_split_note: Tip: set a text anchor to detach the label into its own sub-component.
z80zhealthbar.editor.icon_source_note: Custom icons: put png files into config/z80zhealthbar/icons/.
z80zhealthbar.editor.unsaved_note: Unsaved changes - Save to keep, Discard to roll back to when you entered the editor.
z80zhealthbar.editor.compat_fmt_note: Variables: {name} stat name, {value} current, {max} max. Empty = default Name: value.
z80zhealthbar.editor.asteor.note: Drag bars to move; drag icons to detach.
z80zhealthbar.editor.vanilla_note: Vanilla style is drawn by the game itself (no options). Switch the style above to Long Bars or Custom to edit.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.cornerBarLe: Pixel length of status bars in corner layouts (styles 3-8).
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overlayBarI: Inner height of status bars in pixels (thickness).
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overlayBarV: Vertical gap between adjacent status bars in pixels.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.overlayBarT: Vertical fine-tune of the status value text in pixels.
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.mountHealth: Render the mount health bar on the left side (default right).
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.cornerHoriz: Distance from screen side edges for corner layouts (px).
z80zhealthbar.option.overlay.cornerVerti: Distance from screen top/bottom edges for corner layouts (px).
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.scaleBarWidt: Stretch the bar horizontally only (frame/classic/hearts); leaves height and text untouched. 100% = original width.
z80zhealthbar.option.styleA.scaleBarHeig: Stretch the bar vertically only; leaves width and text untouched; the value text follows the bar-bottom. 100% = original height.
